paragraphs.text: In this work we fabricate perovskite solar cells using a mesoporous TiO2 electron transport layer deposited by spin-coating.
The champion device reaches a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.1% under AM 1.5G illumination at 100 mW cm-2.
Chen et al. previously reported that TiO2-based devices degrade under ultraviolet illumination, which motivated our UV-filtering encapsulation.
